page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Large title in capitals at the top, a short line of Latin verse in italic below it, a central engraved device, then the imprint at the foot. The page shows strong show-through from the reverse, mirrored and faint, which is not transcribed.

main_text.l: P E R P E T V A E[?]
C A R M I N A[?]
A N T V E R P I A E
M D L X X X I V.

page.notes: The engraved device in the centre is an emblematic design with figures and lettering that cannot be read. Much of the title is faint and partly obscured by show-through from the verso, so the readings marked [?] or illegible are uncertain. The date is printed CIↃ. IↃ. LXXXIV. and is given as MDLXXXIV. The imprint line "Excudebat" is read with doubt in its name.
